about.label: About Us
paragraphs: Shabka Ideal Private Limited began in Ranchi with a simple premise: build things properly, close to home, and use those foundations to reach further. That premise now spans construction and real estate, import and export trade, and a growing agro-business arm.
Every division is run with the same directness — decisions made close to the ground, relationships built to last, and quality that doesn't get diluted as the company grows into new markets.

divisions.heading: Three divisions, one standard.
divisions.description: Each business is independently run, sharing only the group's name and its discipline.

items.name: Shabka Constructions
items.description: Real estate development and construction across Ranchi and Jharkhand — residential, commercial, and land development, delivered end to end.

items.name: Shabka Impex
items.description: Import and export trade connecting local suppliers with international markets.

items.name: Shabka Agro
items.description: Farming and agro-business, launching soon as the group's newest venture into cultivation and agricultural trade.
